script_text: The universe just cracked open a door you've been knocking on since January, Gemini, air sign. Monday Mars in your 4th House squares Pluto in your 10th, stirring family drama could derail career plans. Tuesday Mercury, your ruling planet, enters your 1st House and sextiles Uranus, sharpening communication and intuition. Wednesday Venus crosses into your 2nd House, bringing financial relief—your power day. Thursday Saturn stations retrograde in your 12th House, forcing you to face old patterns you've been avoiding. Friday Jupiter trines Uranus from your 4th House, opening a creative or domestic opportunity. Saturday the Sun opposes your natal Mercury, creating miscommunication—your caution day. Venus in your 2nd House supports your love life this week. Sunday Neptune whispers clarity about a secret relationship tension. Trust the weird impulses Uranus triggers in your 1st House—your gut knows what your head refuses to admit. Follow for updates.
